findings.summary: IC power pin U3.1 (VDD) has no DC path to a power rail (net 'PD_VDD')
findings.description: Pin U3.1 (VDD) is type=power_in on net 'PD_VDD'. Graph walk (≤2 hops, rejecting capacitor edges, accepting resistors≤1Ω, inductors, ferrite beads, bridged solder jumpers) did not reach a named power rail. The pin is likely AC-coupled to ground only — the IC will not power up reliably.
findings.recommendation: Verify the schematic for this pin: the DC route must go through a conducting element (direct wire, 0Ω resistor, inductor, ferrite bead, or bridged solder jumper) — not a capacitor. If the intent was to tie VCC through an LC filter, add the missing inductor or 0Ω in series.

report_context.impact: IC supply floats DC; board will not run.

findings.summary: Crystal Y1: load capacitance marginal (8.0pF vs 10.0pF target)
findings.description: Crystal Y1 effective load capacitance is 8.0pF (-20.0% from 10.0pF target from value string). Mismatched CL shifts oscillation frequency and may cause marginal startup.
findings.recommendation: Adjust load capacitors so CL_eff = (C1*C2)/(C1+C2) + C_stray ≈ 10.0pF. Typical C_stray is 3-5pF.

text_annotations.text: ESP32-S3R8 / one controller
V2 Pico replacement. 8 MB internal PSRAM; 16 MB external flash.
100 nF at each supply pin; keep local return paths short.

R8: pads 28, 38-42 are reserved.
Pin 36 = GPIO48; pin 37 = GPIO47.
GPIO42/48: motor EN, pulled inactive.
GPIO1/2 have a short low boot glitch.
Flash / 40 MHz clock

VDD_SPI supplies the 3.3 V Quad flash.
No external loads on the R8 memory pads.

OWMC clock reference; 0402 RF/clock exceptions.
Crystal loading and antenna match checked on hardware.
EEPROM / remaining control I/O

J15 is 2.54 mm; control signals only.
GPIO2: ordinary GPIO, low boot glitch.
GPIO3 / 45 / 46: boot straps; do not override
the reset levels. GPIO46 reserved for inputs here.
I2C pullups use 3.0 V (child display sheet).
Antenna / reset / boot
12 V USB-PD / retained V2 topology

CFG1=0, CFG2=0, CFG3=1 -> 12 V request.
Use the required 12 V PD PSU. VBUS directly feeds VM.
The PD receptacle has no USB data connection.
5 V accessories / V2 TPS5450 retained

Actual IC: TPS5450DDAR; stock TPS5430 symbol uses the same pin map.
EN left open per TI. 5.085 V nominal from V2 divider.
Keep the V2 5 A class; actual board capacity needs load testing.
3.3 V controller supply / replaces Pico regulator
Native USB service / main PD must be on

SERVICE_VBUS is a presence input only.
It never joins the board supply rails.
Switch Ioff isolates an unpowered ESP32.
J16 optional; factory pads support ROM recovery.
Indicators / factory contact pads
TP7 = voltage measurement only. Do not inject 3.3 V.
Motor 1 / UART address 0

800 mA RMS default; software adjustment to 1.2-1.5 A RMS.
Upper setting is not a continuous-current rating.

Motor cable: 1=B2, 2=B1, 3=A1, 4=A2 (V2).
0.11 ohm sense resistors: 1 W / 1%; Kelvin routing.
CLK grounded; internal oscillator. SPREAD=0.
Passive heatsink; exposed pad and ground copper
follow the Fly / TMC reference implementation.
Motor 2 / UART address 1

800 mA RMS default; software adjustment to 1.2-1.5 A RMS.
Upper setting is not a continuous-current rating.

Motor cable: 1=B2, 2=B1, 3=A1, 4=A2 (V2).
0.11 ohm sense resistors: 1 W / 1%; Kelvin routing.
CLK grounded; internal oscillator. SPREAD=0.
Passive heatsink; exposed pad and ground copper
follow the Fly / TMC reference implementation.
Shared addressed UART

TX through 1k to shared RX / PDN_UART.
Initialize UART current and chopper settings before enabling.
Retained scale connection / TTL or RS232

J17: 2-3 = RS232 (default); 1-2 = TTL.
Use one shunt. Keeps the alternative V2 interfaces
without joining two receiver outputs.
J9 retains V2 2 mm DB9 routing selection.
J11 - PWM2 / servo
J12 - PWM1 / servo
J13 - PWM3 / external pixels

Connector order retained: 1 GND / 2 +5V / 3 SIGNAL.
AHCT threshold guarantees a 3.3 V high with a 5 V supply.
Board load envelope: two MG90S servos + four external LEDs.
V2 Mini12864 headers / unchanged pinout

Use one display assembly at a time; power off before changing.
Mini encoder / click inputs use 3.3 V pullups in the MCU.
EXP2.8 gets a 5 V tolerant input buffer for the Mini button.
EXP2.10 stays +5 V: the supplied Mini must have no fitted
KILL link that shorts this contact when its button is pressed.
External QSPI assembly / board connector only

TDO TS040WVS02CP-B1617A: 3.95 inch, 480 x 480.
QSPI factory straps required on the supplied display.
D0..D3 / CLK / CS, RESET, WAIT and direct touch I2C.
Bridge IRQ and D/C unused for this connection.
FFC: confirm contact side, thickness and pin 1 mapping
with the supplied assembly before PCB placement.
3.0 V touch power / shared I2C pullups

LDO always fitted, including Mini mode.
I2C pullups are on root sheet; use open drain.
GPIO44 high asserts touch RESET low.
